selected.title: Trinity77.jpg (Commodore PET 2001, Apple II, TRS-80 Model I, the "1977 Trinity")
selected.creator: Tim Colegrove (Wikimedia Commons user Springsgrace)
selected.depicted_event_date: 2019-05-25: collector's working hardware photographed in 2019. This is not a period (1977-1982) photograph.

depicted_hardware.product: Radio Shack TRS-80 Model I (keyboard/CPU unit, Expansion Interface, Video Display)
depicted_hardware.rom_version: unknown; the screen shows no ROM revision
evidence: Keyboard unit and Expansion Interface badges read 'Radio Shack TRS-80'. The monitor badge reads 'Radio Shack' / 'VIDEO DISPLAY'.
On-screen text at native resolution: 'MEMORY SIZE?' (twice), 'RADIO SHACK LEVEL II BASIC', 'READY', '>MEM', '31956' (best reading), 'READY', '>_'.
The Radio Shack Level II BASIC Reference Manual (1978) documents the same power-up sequence: 'memory size?', then 'RADIO SHACK LEVEL II BASIC' and 'READY'.
Commons file categories include 'TRS-80 Model I'. The author's description names the machine as the TRS-80 Model I.

version_used.reason: The unedited camera original. The current Commons version (2024-01-30, Pittigrilli, sha1 87af88f4...) and the 2024-01-29 version are geometric-distortion corrections by a third party and were not used.
